d: A policeman starts a personal vendetta against the killers of his son, a young prizefighter who had been bribed to fix a fight.
Steve warns Dilys of theft risk, but she scorns him. In Hawaii for vacation, Steve suspects Dilys brought a valuable ruby & tries to protect her, but faces resistance. Can he save her from theft?
Paul Williams as Stringer snaps pic of secret meeting of racketeer Alika and influence peddler Kramer, uses it to extort Kramer, putting himself in danger from Alika.

Steve McGarrett chases after ex-cop, now private detective, Russ Hendrix, whom he admires but suspects of killing Honolulu pimps. Hendrix knows McGarrett is onto him, making the pursuit dangerous. Will McGarrett bring the murderer to justice?
Steve suspects Dr. Danworth of illegally supplying drugs to addicts, must build case while protecting him from vengeful father. Addict's overdose prompts investigation.
Steve hunts down Skyline Killer but is hindered by writer Norman Klane who wants to sell the killer's story for big bucks & divide the fortune with the murderer.

Steve McGarrett investigates the death of a young Asian girl on a flight from Bangkok to Honolulu. The girl was a heroin courier for a drug ring in Singapore. McGarrett sets out to dismantle the operation and uncover the truth behind the girl's death.

McGarrett finds himself caught in the crossfire as a faction of embattled Hawaiian natives take on the Island's underworld. The prize -- control of a labor union and the 50th state's rich tourist business.

Honolulu policewoman Lori Wilson is on the scene when her husband, Honolulu cop and Five-O recruit, Kevin Wilson, is gunned down by bandits. McGarrett brings Five-O into the search for Wilson's killer.
McGarrett goes after a unique secret ring of high-society vigilantes who are determined to see that justice is done -- even if they have to do it themselves.
Jayne Meadows guest stars as an astrologer whose ominous warnings tempt the skeptical Steve McGarrett to follow her clues in his investigation of a murder.

st: Good Help is Hard to Find
d: Is the Five-O crew as foolish and inept as they are beginning to appear to the public?

Someone apparently is trying to convince Joan Carter and everyone she knows that she is mentally ill and only imagining the frightening attacks on her life, but one of those people — Five-O boss Steve McGarrett — isn't buying it.

st: Use a Gun, Go to Hell
d: In a powerful episode playing upon the easy availability of handguns, McGarrett and his Five-O unit follow the trail of pain and death left by one of the weapons, hoping to recover it before it can wreak yet more havoc.

Tension, barely controlled fury and gut-numbing fear -- it's all there as Steve McGarrett confronts a pair of political terrorists who are threatening to kill their policewomanhostage unless their demands are met.
Steve McGarrett finds himself dealing with apparent psychic phenomena as he tries to trace the whereabouts of a jewel cache worth $2 million.
